description: Fail-closed registry for every GitHub Actions job with an effective write permission. Unregistered writes and mutable action refs are forbidden.

deploy.purpose: Publish the exact readiness-authorized site to GitHub Pages
deploy.repositoryBoundary: same repository; automatic promotion only from successful main readiness
deploy.branchBoundary: exact readiness head SHA or explicit operator recovery SHA

record.purpose: Record an idempotent capability witness for one exact successful Pages deploy run
record.repositoryBoundary: same repository deploy run resolved through the Actions API
record.branchBoundary: main deployment head SHA and trusted recorder source
mutationTargets: machine-marked deployment witness issue or pull-request thread

lifecycle.purpose: Open, update, and recover one factual CI incident per workflow and branch or pull request identity
lifecycle.repositoryBoundary: same repository workflow_run metadata; triggering branch code is never executed
lifecycle.branchBoundary: notifier implementation fetched from the trusted default branch

placement-autofix.purpose: Apply deterministic glossary, tooltip, and asset-revision normalization to an explicitly labelled same-repository pull request
placement-autofix.branchBoundary: exact pull-request head branch carrying the autofix label
mutationTargets: pull-request source branch glossary and tooltip normalization

search-manifest-autofix.purpose: Apply deterministic search-manifest and RSS normalization to an explicitly labelled same-repository pull request
search-manifest-autofix.branchBoundary: exact pull-request head branch carrying the autofix label
mutationTargets: feed.xml and route/search policy manifests on the pull-request source branch
